title: Above The Leaves: Survival
description: You can only walk on leaves! Touch the ground and you will die through it.
body:
# **🍃 Above the Leaves**

Forget the ground. Forget the rocks. Your survival journey begins high above the world, suspended in a sea of ​​greenery.

"Above the Leaves" is a unique and challenging addition that completely overturns the traditional Minecraft start. Instead of crashing into trees, your journey begins on a floating canopy of leaves, forcing you to adapt, think creatively, and progress using only what the plants provide.

**A real challenge:** You must always stay above the leaves to survive.

### **Note:**
If you land on the leaves, you will die instantly, as shown in the image.

![dead](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b3213e86513d7be11e61b613fb8d446ef4aa8c9d.png)
### **🛠️ How to Play:**

Create a new world by installing the data pack.

Overcome the initial landing on leaves by spawning in a tree.

Build a bridge to progress in classic Minecraft.

Ready to conquer the treetops? Download the add-on now and prove your survival skills... above the leaves.

### **Example attached:**

![above the leaves](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/48b063af776961aa0293dcc4903636e37ad52be2.png)

### Compatibility:

Requires **1.21.1** Fabric/Forge/NeoForge **(Optional)**. Copyright: JaliluFox


[CurseForge](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/data-packs/above-the-leaves-survival)
